_contract.purpose: Frozen consumer contract for the Atlas Codex 'Paid' preset (lane 4, rev 2). The access field is the lane-3 frozen column: standard | paid | royal. Never invent a parallel tier field.
rules: access is one of: standard | paid | royal.
Join key against js/heroes-data.js allHeroesData is the hero name (string equality).
A hero missing from this fixture set falls back to access = paid when State is 'Paid'.
Every record carries the provenance 5-field envelope (source, author, captureDate, gameVersionScope, verificationStatus).
